description: Copia org-wide Renovate base policy. Extend with local>copia-automation/.github

lockFileMaintenance.description: Enabled weekly by config:best-practices; moved from its Monday 00:00-03:59 default into the Sunday routine window

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes start daily between 04:00 and 08:59 and, by Renovate default, have no PR limit

packageRules.description: Rollbacks and replacements should be deliberate human calls, not bot PRs
Overrides and resolutions are deliberate human pins on transitive deps; Renovate must not touch them
Batch all non-major updates per manager so the 3-PR budget covers every ecosystem; majors stay individual
Family group for majors: eslint, its plugins/configs and parsers move together (9 of the top 20 repos). Built-in groups split them across eslint, typescript-eslint and stylistic
Adds the eslint companions that packages:eslint does not list
Family group for majors: vite majors drag plugins and vitest with them (6 repos). Separate rules because one rule ANDs its matchers
Adds vitest and @vitest/* to the vite major group
Family group for majors: electron majors usually need the packaging toolchain bumped too (4 repos)
Family group for majors: webpack core and CLI/dev-server majors are coupled (4 repos)
Family group for majors: pytest plugins track pytest majors (4 repos)
